format: json-schema (structured outputs): {mushroom, composition[{compound, amount, effect}], maxItems 100}
system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"mushroom": "...", "composition": [{"compound": "...", "amount": "...", "effect": "..."}]}. In "amount" give a number with a unit (% of fresh weight, % of dry weight, mg/kg, mg/g, or per fruiting body) — if you do not know, write "unknown". In "effect" give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. Answer in English. No text outside the JSON.

turns.prompt: List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of fly agaric (Amanita muscaria).

composition.влияние: A GABA-A receptor agonist that produces sedation, drowsiness, and at higher doses visual hallucinations and excitement.

A provitamin that, upon exposure to UV light, is converted to vitamin D₂ and contributes to bone and calcium metabolism.

turns.prompt: List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of panther cap (Amanita pantherina).

composition.влияние: Excitatory neurotoxin and structural glutamate analog that overstimulates NMDA and AMPA receptors, causing tremors, hyperexcitability, and, at higher doses, convulsions.
Potent GABA-A receptor agonist that produces CNS depression, sedation, ataxia, and can induce visual and auditory hallucinations.

A fungal sterol (analog of vitamin D in plants) that is metabolised to vitamin D3 upon UV exposure and serves as a precursor in human vitamin-D metabolism.

turns.prompt: List the main chemical compounds found in the fruiting bodies of death cap (Amanita phalloides).

composition.влияние: Inhibits RNA polymerase II in eukaryotic cells, causing death of hepatocytes and renal tubular cells and leading to hepatic and renal failure.

Inhibits RNA polymerase at lower affinity, producing milder cell death in liver and kidney.
Weakest inhibitor of RNA polymerase II among amatoxins; contributes minimally to the acute toxic syndrome.
Binds to and severs actin filaments, disrupting the cytoskeleton and impairing cell motility and structural integrity.
Binds actin filaments with lower affinity than α-phallotoxin, causing less severe disruption of cell motility.
Weakest actin-binding phallotoxin; causes mild impairment of cytoskeletal function.
